**Checklist**

- [ ] `go build ./...`, `go test ./...`, `gofmt -l .` (no output) and `go vet ./...` all pass
- [ ] If it affects a build, an image built with it **boots without errors** (say how you checked)
- [ ] Commits are scoped; messages say what the change does
- [ ] Docs updated if the change alters what the tool does or how it is used
- [ ] No Microsoft files or third-party media added
- [ ] If you used an AI tool, said which and how (see CONTRIBUTING.md § AI-assisted contributions)
